text: This dashboard needs its own calculated fields, the Tableau equivalent of a DAX measure, built on top of the live warehouse connection from Lesson 16.

Tableau's real equivalent of CALCULATE with ALL is a Level of Detail expression using FIXED, with no dimensions named inside the braces. That computes one single company-wide total, ignoring whatever filter the current view has applied — the exact same effect ALL has in DAX.

Tableau offers three LOD keywords, but only FIXED with nothing named inside it produces a genuinely constant value no matter what's on the sheet — INCLUDE and EXCLUDE both still shift with the view's own dimensions.
Next lesson takes this working dashboard and formats it specifically for a Board audience that's part internal, part external, and not expected to interpret a raw analytical tool.
